# Popl

> > Popl is a GTM platform that enables go-to-market teams to capture, enrich, and sync in-person event leads directly to their CRM.

Popl provides event lead capture solutions through badge scanning, digital business cards, and AI-powered list enrichment. The platform integrates natively with major CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Marketo, helping sales and marketing teams maximize event ROI.

## Key Topics

- Event Lead Capture
- Badge Scanning
- CRM Integration
- Lead Enrichment
- Go-to-Market (GTM)
- Digital Business Cards
- Salesforce
- HubSpot
- Marketo
- Lead Qualification
- Event Intelligence
- Data Enrichment
- Sales Automation
- Mobile App
- QR Codes

## Core Products

- [Event Lead Capture](https://popl.co/pages/event-lead-capture): Core product page: badge scanning, lead enrichment, and CRM sync features
- [Badge Scanner](https://popl.co/pages/badge-scanner): Universal badge scanner product: mobile app for iOS/Android event lead capture
- [Digital Business Card Platform](https://popl.co/pages/digital-business-card): Digital business card product: team management, QR codes, CRM integration
- [List Enrichment](https://popl.co/pages/list-enrichment): List enrichment product: AI-powered data enrichment for event attendee lists
- [Event Intelligence](https://popl.co/pages/event-intelligence): Event Intelligence product: buyer prospecting and attendee/exhibitor data discovery

## CRM Integrations

- [Salesforce Integration](https://popl.co/pages/salesforce-integration): Salesforce integration: native CRM sync for event leads with SOC 2 certification
- [HubSpot Integration](https://popl.co/pages/hubspot-integration): HubSpot integration: native CRM sync for event leads with lead attribution
- [Marketo Integration](https://popl.co/pages/marketo-integration): Marketo integration: native CRM sync with data enrichment and deduplication
- [All Integrations](https://popl.co/pages/integrations): Integrations hub: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, and marketing automation tools
